extension.description: A community-developed unofficial VS Code extension for working with WCH projects from MounRiver Studio.
viewContainer.title: WCH VS Code Extension
configuration.title: wch-vscode
configuration.mounRiverStudioPath.descri: MounRiver Studio installation root, e.g. F:\MounRiver\MounRiver_Studio2
configuration.buildMethod.description: Select how WCH projects are built: the extension parses the project parameters and calls make, or MRS parses the parameters and builds.
configuration.buildMethod.make.label: Plugin parses parameters
configuration.buildMethod.mrsCli.label: MRS parses parameters
configuration.buildMethod.make: Plugin parses parameters: the extension parses the project configuration, generates makefiles, and calls make directly.
configuration.buildMethod.mrsCli: MRS parses parameters: MRS parses the project configuration and builds itself, identical to building inside MRS.
configuration.resetMode.description: Select how the target is reset before download/debug and after download.
configuration.resetMode.nrst.label: Normal reset
configuration.resetMode.powerOff.label: Power-off reset
configuration.resetMode.nrst: Normal reset: use the reset pin, same as the previous behavior.
configuration.resetMode.powerOff: Power-off reset: turn off the selected WCH-Link reset voltage, wait, then power on again. The target must be powered by WCH-Link.
configuration.powerOffDelayMs.descriptio: Wait time in milliseconds after turning off the reset voltage before powering on again. Increase this value if the target board has large capacitors or boots slowly.
configuration.powerOutput.description: Select the WCH-Link reset voltage used by power-off reset.
configuration.powerOutput.3v3.label: 3.3V
configuration.powerOutput.5v.label: 5V
configuration.powerOutput.3v3: Switch the WCH-Link 3.3V output. Use this for most WCH boards.
configuration.powerOutput.5v: Switch the WCH-Link 5V output. Use this when the target board is powered from 5V.
